name: Rufina
source:
A princess knight of the highest rank in the spirit world.
She is a legendary hero who was once summoned by a high-ranking saint and saved the world from a crisis, and is revered by the people.
She is earnest, cool, and unfazed by anything. She is has a kind heart, but has no mercy for vile people.

Translated from https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01050320.html
